summary_1line: Hanuman stealthily enters the Ashoka Grove in Lanka, marvels at its beauty, and hides in a tree hoping to spot the sorrowful Sita.

image_candidates.scene_text: Hanuman leaps into the Ashoka Grove as startled birds take flight and a shower of multicolored blossoms falls over his body.
Hidden among the leaves of a golden Shingshapa tree, Hanuman scans the lush garden below hoping to glimpse the grieving Sita.
A sparkling river cascades from a hill like a fleeing maiden while tree branches brush the water as if trying to hold her back.
